WITH weekend_hours AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN substr(opening_time, -2) = 'PM' AND CAST(substr(opening_time, 1, length(opening_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) <> 12 THEN (CAST(substr(opening_time, 1, length(opening_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) + 12) * 60
         WHEN substr(opening_time, -2) = 'AM' AND CAST(substr(opening_time, 1, length(opening_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) = 12 THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(substr(opening_time, 1, length(opening_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 END AS opening_minutes,
    CASE WHEN substr(closing_time, -2) = 'PM' AND CAST(substr(closing_time, 1, length(closing_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) <> 12 THEN (CAST(substr(closing_time, 1, length(closing_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) + 12) * 60
         WHEN substr(closing_time, -2) = 'AM' AND CAST(substr(closing_time, 1, length(closing_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) = 12 THEN 0
         ELSE CAST(substr(closing_time, 1, length(closing_time) - 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 END AS closing_minutes
  FROM Business_Hours AS h
  JOIN Days AS d ON h.day_id = d.day_id
  WHERE h.business_id = 1 AND d.day_of_week IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday')
)
SELECT AVG((closing_minutes - opening_minutes) / 2.0) AS average_business_time
FROM weekend_hours;
